- Vendored paths: `src/core/`, `src/devices/sticks3/`
- Local extension: `src/devices/cores3/` follows the upstream device-authoring

- License declaration: `MIT` in the upstream `README.md` and `package.json`

The pinned upstream commit does not contain a standalone `LICENSE` file. Keep
this notice with the copied source and replace it with the upstream license
file when the project publishes one.

The copy is otherwise unmodified. Local integration belongs in
`platform/web/sticks3-viewer.js`.
